text:
hana.l: Heads-up — we have a generation failure in this morning's batch: a reserved capacity credit was posted to the sibling tenant and one draft lost the GPU compute line. Spotted in pre-send QA.

dan.p: which invoice ids? were any emails sent?

hana.l: drafts only. INV-2026-0721A (tenant: skylab-main) missing compute_gpu_hours line; INV-2026-0721B (skylab-ops) shows the -reserved_credit that should be on A. batch rb-20260721-2.

billing-bot: Reconciler report: batch_id=rb-20260721-2, processed=943, anomalies=credit_misalloc, duplicate_draft, trimmed_lines.

owen.s: my hunch — credit posting used tenant_key from payment instruments table that had stale mapping to sibling account. Also rounding filter suppressed a tiny net line when total went negative.

talia.rev: this affects revenue recognition. we need a manual journal and a clear audit trail before reissue.

hana.l: proposed steps: 1) pause outbound for this batch, 2) reassign credit to correct tenant in billing DB with audit note, 3) regenerate and consolidate into one final invoice INV-2026-0721, 4) send customer note explaining drafts and final invoice.

dan.p: please add detection SQL to find other occurrences.

owen.s: example queries:
SELECT cp.credit_id, cp.posted_to_tenant, i.tenant_id, i.invoice_number FROM credit_postings cp JOIN invoices i ON i.id = cp.invoice_id WHERE cp.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND cp.posted_to_tenant <> i.tenant_id;
SELECT invoice_number FROM invoices WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING count(*) > 1;

billing-bot: Action tas-5120 created (label: credit-misalloc). Assigned to @owen.s.

talia.rev: finance: once CSV of suspects is ready I'll validate and then sign off on manual reassign + consolidated reissue. Also include a 'manual credit adjustment' line in audit.

hana.l: uploaded CSV to /shared/finance/misalloc-20260721.csv. found 3 historical similar cases in last 30 days. Paused auto-accept for billing fuzzy rules.

dan.p: thanks. after fix, add console alert when credit_postings.tenant_id != invoice.tenant_id for any batch.

owen.s: will add alert ticket and run backfill script to correct confirmed misallocs. ETA 4h for remediation + regen pending finance signoff.

talia.rev: ACK. draft customer note: "We found duplicate draft invoices due to an internal credit allocation issue. Only the final invoice will be issued; please disregard drafts. We are correcting the allocation and will send the corrected invoice with an audit note."

hana.l: closing loop for now — reopen if customers see draft emails or if anything unexpected shows in the regen.
